errors.evidence: The bars are grouped horizontally by specialty, not vertically. The description incorrectly implies vertical grouping.
The description omits the value range and tick intervals of the y-axis (ranging from -27 to -22 with intervals of one unit).
The description does not mention the specific colors associated with each specialty in the legend (light blue, light orange, orange, darker orange, light brown, medium brown, dark brown).
The description omits the observation that the light blue bars (MistralV0.2-Base) are always the tallest in each group.
The description does not mention the relative heights of the bars across specialties (e.g., Cardio bars are taller overall, Infect bars are shorter overall).
The description omits the position of the legend (top center).
The description does not explicitly state that all bars start from -22 downwards towards -27.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the performance of the MistralV0.2-Base model fine-tuned on different specialties.

errors.text_span: comparing a baseline model to various fine-tuned models
errors.evidence: The description oversimplifies the comparison by not specifying that the baseline model is MistralV0.2-Base and the fine-tuned models correspond to the listed specialties.
